name: ynab-local
description: Read your YNAB budgets, accounts and transactions through your private server, with optional edits.

interface.shortDescription: Your budget, connected through your home server
interface.longDescription: Review YNAB budgets, accounts, categories, upcoming transactions and spending. Edits are disabled by default and can be enabled by the server owner. A personal integration, independent of YNAB.
defaultPrompt: Review my budget for this month.
